evidence: Touches descriptor parsing and extended key decoding in `src/script/descriptor.cpp` and `src/key_io.cpp`, which are core to wallet key and descriptor management.
rationale: Optimizing descriptor parsing by ~30% via unified Base58Check decoding and character lookup tables is a solid optimization with real value for fuzzing and descriptor loading, but the sub-millisecond savings per descriptor are reasonably deferrable. Reviewers and author confirm a 29–37% speedup on `ParseDescriptor` microbenchmarks (from 127 µs to 90 µs on large multisig descriptors) with concrete benefit for descriptor fuzz targets.
